title: Atomic structure
overview: A focused revision guide to atomic structure.

sections.title: Subatomic particles
content: Protons (+1), neutrons (0), electrons (−1, negligible mass). Atomic number = protons; mass number = protons + neutrons. Isotopes share atomic number but differ in neutron count.

sections.title: Ionisation energy trends
content: Increases across a period (more protons, same shell); decreases down a group (extra shielding shells, greater distance).

examTips: Explain trends with all three factors — nuclear charge, shielding, atomic radius — even if one dominates; the mark scheme usually credits the full explanation.
